title: SOMA Brewing Company
description: India's first non-alcoholic craft brewery: catalog, nutrition, wallet, checkout links for AI agents.
summary: India's first non-alcoholic craft brewery: catalog, nutrition, wallet, checkout links for AI agents.
offersHint: India's first non-alcoholic craft brewery: catalog, nutrition, wallet, checkout links for AI agents. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://getsoma.store/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_brand
toolsPreview.description: Brand overview: who SOMA is, taglines, founder, location, contact details, social handles, and the 2026 pivot from sparkling water to non-alcoholic craft beer.

toolsPreview.name: list_beers
toolsPreview.description: Full product lineup with style, tasting profile, ABV, calories, carbs, pricing (can/6-pack in INR), food pairings, availability status, and brewing notes.

toolsPreview.name: get_beer
toolsPreview.description: Detailed spec for a single beer by slug: lager, ipa, belgian-wit, or stout.

toolsPreview.name: get_pricing_and_delivery
toolsPreview.description: Retail prices per beer (500ml can ₹199 / MRP ₹249, 6-pack ₹1,194 / MRP ₹1,494), delivery cities (Bangalore live; Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Delhi, Ahmedabad, Jaipur next), and the flat delivery fee.

toolsPreview.name: get_subscription_plans
toolsPreview.description: The three monthly beer subscription tiers with pricing, savings percentage, and included perks. All plans have free delivery and pause-anytime.

toolsPreview.name: get_b2b_wholesale
toolsPreview.description: B2B pricing tiers for restaurants, bars, hotels, and events (per-can INR by monthly volume), keg/draft options, and how to book a tasting.

toolsPreview.name: get_brewing_process
toolsPreview.description: The six-step production process (mash, boil, full fermentation, vacuum distillation, re-carbonation, lab testing), ingredient sourcing, and certifications.

toolsPreview.name: get_faq
toolsPreview.description: All customer FAQs: what SOMA is, ABV and trace alcohol, brewing method, styles, pricing, delivery, age policy, comparisons to other NA beers, subscriptions, recycling, and wholesale.

toolsPreview.name: get_recipes
toolsPreview.description: Non-alcoholic beer cocktail recipes (shandies, beer-mosa, michelada, stout float) with ingredients and method, plus the food pairing guide per beer.

toolsPreview.name: get_buy_link
toolsPreview.description: Builds a direct buy link an agent can hand to the user. With Shopify variant IDs configured it returns a cart permalink that lands in checkout pre-filled; otherwise it returns the product page on the shop. Payment always happens on Shopify's checkout with the human in control — this tool never charges anyone.

toolsPreview.name: join_waitlist
toolsPreview.description: Signs a user up for SOMA's pre-launch waitlist (the Founding Fifty — first tasters get first-batch priority in Bangalore). Only call this with the user's explicit consent; it stores their contact in SOMA's CRM and sends a one-time welcome email. Idempotent: signing up twice never double-sends.

toolsPreview.name: get_health_nutrition
toolsPreview.description: Machine-readable nutrition per beer for health, fitness, and diet-tracking platforms: per-can and per-100ml calories, carbs, protein, sugar, ABV, allergens, and dietary flags.

toolsPreview.name: get_wallet
toolsPreview.description: READ-ONLY wallet summary for a SOMA app user: their SOMA Coins balance plus a summary of coins expiring within the next 30 days. Requires a wallet token that only the human can generate inside the SOMA mobile app (Wallet tab → 'Share balance with your AI') — ask them for it; tokens expire after ~10 minutes. This tool can never claim, redeem, spend, or move coins (there are deliberately no claim/redeem tools over MCP). Returns { error: 'invalid_or_expired_token' } for a bad or stale token — ask the user to generate a fresh one in the app.
